description: Order book liquidity of one coin: depth within bands around the mid (bids vs asks, imbalance) and the largest walls with their status (active, pulled before the price arrived, filled). Use it for support / resistance from resting orders.

coin.description: Coin name as on Hyperliquid, e.g. BTC, ETH, kPEPE, xyz:TSLA (case-insensitive).

venue.description: Only this venue (default every venue the licence allows).

name: get_orderbook

depth.description: Depth per band: pct, bidUsd, askUsd, imbalance.

error.description: Only on a failed call (isError: true): code, message and, from the API, status, param, doc_url, request_id.

meta.description: The API meta block: updatedAt, source (venues), sources, plan, delayMinutes, license, attribution (the credit line to show), access, warnings, restricted.

venues.description: Venues with a fresh book (without the levels).

walls.description: Walls: side, px, venue, usd, maxUsd, status.

title: Order book and walls
